facts.text: A regression is a previously passing case that fails after a software or settings change; regression testing reruns a fixed set of cases after every change to detect such failures.
facts.quote: A regression is a case that used to pass and now fails after a change to the software or the settings, and regression testing is the habit of rerunning a fixed set of cases after every change to catch exactly that.

facts.text: Lowering a threshold to detect a previously missed worker can cause braking for every berm.
facts.quote: a threshold lowered to catch one missed worker may now brake for every berm.

facts.text: Requirement and regression testing is one of the booklet's three campaign classes: deterministic pass-or-fail cases tied to individual requirements are rerun continually to check whether software or calibration changes broke required behavior.
facts.quote: requirement and regression testing is one of the three campaign classes: deterministic pass-or-fail cases tied to individual requirements, rerun continually

facts.text: Every failure found by search becomes a permanent regression test.
facts.quote: Every failure found by search becomes a permanent regression test.

facts.text: Chapter 9 specifies a fast smoke subset of software-in-the-loop runs on every code change.
facts.quote: a fast "smoke" subset of software-in-the-loop runs on every code change

facts.text: Chapter 9 specifies a small mandatory safety regression set on every eligible build.
facts.quote: a small mandatory safety regression set on every eligible build

facts.text: Chapter 9 specifies larger virtual test campaigns overnight or at release gates.
facts.quote: larger virtual campaigns overnight or at release gates

facts.text: Chapter 9 recommends choosing hardware-in-the-loop and physical confirmation tests by risk.
facts.quote: hardware-in-the-loop and physical confirmation chosen by risk.

facts.text: A change-impact graph selects scenarios affected by a change: a brake-model change selects stopping-margin scenarios, while a perception change selects everything downstream of detections.
facts.quote: A change-impact graph picks the scenarios a change touches: a brake-model change selects stopping-margin scenarios, a perception change selects everything downstream of detections

facts.text: To protect statistical validity, the frozen estimation set is run only at release candidates and must not be continuously rerun and optimized against.
facts.quote: The frozen estimation set is run only at release candidates, never continuously rerun and optimized against.

facts.text: A late change to a safety-relevant decision threshold triggers new independent statistical confirmation for the affected claim, rather than merely rerunning the failures that prompted the change.
facts.quote: a late change to a safety-relevant decision threshold triggers a new independent statistical confirmation for the affected claim, not merely a rerun of the failures that caused the change

facts.text: In the program's four-month window with many late corrections, regression testing prevents a fix in one stratum from silently undoing a passing result in another.
facts.quote: In a four-month window with many late corrections, regression testing keeps a fix in one stratum from silently undoing a pass in another.

facts.text: Running millions of regression tests does not demonstrate that the test set represents the real operating domain.
facts.quote: Chapter 1 cautions that running millions of regression tests does not show that the test set represents the real operating domain [Chapter 1, Chapter 9].
